notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]
・[b]Added protagonist voice acting[/b]: The main character now features full voice acting throughout the game, enhancing the storytelling experience and bringing more personality to your journey.
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
・Fixed various minor bugs and issues to improve overall game stability and performance.
